literal.prompt: Как называется специализированная розничная торговая точка, продающая книги?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The clarified prompt requires a specialized retail outlet. MW defines a bookstore as a place of business where books are the main item offered for sale; AAP confirms publishers also sell works but describes them as curating/developing/editing/distributing written works. This distinguishes the retail venue from a publisher that can sell its output.
literalGroups.locator: MW bookstore lines 31–40, 82–93; AAP printed p.15 paragraphs 52–53 (web-reader lines 382–402)

literalGroups.literal: Книжный магазин — специализированная розничная точка, где книги предлагают покупателям. Издательство может продавать свои произведения, но также отбирает и организует выпуск книг.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW supports a bookstore as a retail business where books are the main item; AAP supports that publishers may sell works and also curate, edit and distribute them.
literalGroups.locator: MW bookstore lines 31–40, 82–93; AAP printed p.15 paragraphs 52–53

literalGroups.literal: Библиотеки приобретают информационные ресурсы, сохраняют культурное наследие и выдают книги и другие материалы.
literalGroups.primaryGround: ALA says libraries acquire information resources, preserve cultural heritage, and lend books or other resources; this is access/lending, not a specialized book-retail outlet.

literalGroups.literal: Словарь Merriam-Webster приводит для bookstore и альтернативное название bookshop.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW says a bookstore is a business where books are the main item offered for sale and calls it also bookshop. The alternate term is a concrete extra fact beyond the new retail-outlet prompt and key.

literalGroups.literal: Издатели отбирают, редактируют и распространяют произведения, доводя книги до читателей.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP says publishers curate what is published, develop/edit/market/distribute works, and may sell them. That supports the note while distinguishing the publisher role from the specialized retail venue requested.

literalGroups.literal: Книжные типографии печатают и могут переплетать книги, не выступая издателем.
literalGroups.primaryGround: PRINTING United defines book printers as printing or printing-and-binding without publishing; this describes production, not book retail.
